title: Stage2-L MR2 17-event coverage diagnostic controlled comparison plan
purpose: Bind the MR1 baseline, both protocols, comparator implementation and decision rules before the MR2 report exists.

required_integrity: both runs have exactly 40 finite optimizer steps
losses and release thresholds are unchanged
both runs use fresh initialization from the same ORION checkpoint and config
MR2 uses the same frozen MR1 base trainer implementation
MR1 train/dev events are strict split-preserving subsets of MR2 train/dev
train and dev gate keys are identical in MR1 and MR2 reports
every optimizer step covers the entire corresponding train split
every train event receives exactly 40 primary presentations
trajectory, control, Density UQ and governor remain disabled

all_train_and_dev_gates_pass.next_action: Use only to design formal training after exact24 and human-review gates; do not launch automatically.

train_gate_count_improves_and_dev_gate_c.next_action: Stop repeated MR scaling and revise objective, capacity or label support.

dev_gate_count_improves_and_train_does_n.next_action: Inspect only remaining preregistered gates and absent class cells; formal training stays locked.

otherwise.next_action: Stop route or step scaling and revise the relevance or structured-field objective.

integrity_failure.next_action: Do not interpret MR2; repair lineage or protocol drift without rerunning automatically.

claim_boundary: The eventual MR2 comparison is an engineering train/dev diagnostic. It is not a formal generalization, VLM understanding, planning, closed-loop or safety result.
